names.why: The calendar date of 11-27 is wrong. NAT's own shareholder letter of 2026-11-09 says 'Numbers for the third quarter of 2026 will be released on Monday November 30, 2026'. The vendors disagree among themselves (Yahoo 11-27 20:00 UTC, Earnings Whispers and Bullstory 11-26), which marks them as projections.
names.session_evidence: The company letter gives the date but not the hour. NAT holds no call and has put out its last two quarterly reports before the US open: the Q2 2026 report at 05:50 ET on 2026-08-27 (https://finviz.com/news/386015/nordic-american-tankers-ltd-nyse-nat-report-as-per-june-30-2026-the-direction-of-nat-is-unquestionably-upwards-rates-values-are-up) and the Q3 2025 report at 05:13 ET on 2025-11-28 (https://finviz.com/news/240596/nordic-american-tankers-ltd-nyse-nat-report-as-per-september-30-2025-increased-dividend-and-solid-prospects). A Monday 11-30 release therefore lands bmo, which makes the 11-30 bmo window the one to score.
where_to_look: The dividend. NAT pays out essentially all free cash and the per-share dividend is the headline number (Q2: $0.27, up from $0.22). Q3 suezmax spot TCE against NAT's own Q3 fixtures implies the payout, so compare the 2026-11-09 letter's commentary ('tanker bonanza') with Baltic TD20/TD6 suezmax averages for Q3 and Q4-to-date.

One-offs in the Q2 comparison. Q2 net income of $68.3m included about $21.3m of vessel-sale and insurance gains (https://pulse2.com/nordic-american-tankers-q2-tce-reaches-63000-per-day-as-net-result-rises-48-sequentially-and-cash-hits-175-million/), so a Q3 without them is a lower base. Check for any Q3 vessel sales in 6-Ks.
Whether the ATM equity program stays unused. Management stressed no ATM use in 2026, so look at 6-Ks for any F-3 or ATM activity.
Q4-to-date booking disclosure, which NAT sometimes gives in the report and which drives the forward read.
